translations.web: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”
translations.bsb: But as for Me, I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. I will bring their deeds down upon their own heads.”
translations.kjv: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
translations.asv: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way upon their head.
